name: Frequency 36 Choice
definition: Choice of format for a frequency, for example, the frequency of payment.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies a frequency in terms of a specified period type.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Specifies a frequency in terms of a count per period within a specified period type.

PointInTime.name: Point In Time
PointInTime.definition: Specifies a frequency in terms of an exact point in time or moment within a specified period type.
